The absolute-trend gate has historically provided drawdown protection; momentum ranks have no return-forecasting edge. The challenger Memory/Storage is distant (margin 0.217) and lacks trend clarity. The macro backdrop is dominated by AI/tech narratives with high unscheduled-surprise share, not a trigger.
emerging_watch: Memory, HBM & Storage (challenger, rank 2, but durability 0.45 and breadth 0.0): watch for a confirmed leadership handoff — if this theme's detector rank score closes above Cybersecurity's rank score for 5 consecutive trading days and its durability_bar rises above 0.6, that would signal a durable shift.
